title: Father's Day Stories
prompt: Tell a story about a special daddy and what makes him special.
hint: Think about how the daddy shows love, protection, or teaches important lessons.
sample: Joseph was a kind carpenter who protected baby Jesus and taught him how to work hard and love God.

ja.prompt: 特別なお父さんについての話をしてください。どんなところが特別ですか？
ja.hint: お父さんがどのように愛を示したり、守ったり、大切なことを教えたりするかを考えてみましょう。
ja.sample: ヨセフは優しい大工で、赤ちゃんイエスを守り、一生懸命働くことや神様を愛することを教えました。

local.prompt: Tell a story about a special daddy and what makes him special.

local.sample: Joseph was a kind carpenter who protected baby Jesus and taught him how to work hard and love God.

zh.prompt: 講一個關於特別爸爸的故事，他有什麼特別之處？
zh.hint: 想想爸爸如何表達愛、保護家人或教導重要的事情。
zh.sample: 約瑟是一位善良的木匠，他保護嬰兒耶穌，並教他努力工作和愛神。

en.hint: Think about how the daddy shows love, protection, or teaches important lessons.
en.sample: Joseph was a kind carpenter who protected baby Jesus and taught him how to work hard and love God.

title: The Lost Son and the Loving Father
prompt: Describe the story of the lost son and how his father reacted when he returned.
hint: Focus on the father's feelings and actions when he saw his son again.
sample: The father ran to his lost son, hugged him tightly, and threw a big party to celebrate his return.

ja.prompt: 迷子になった息子の話と、息子が帰ってきたときお父さんがどうしたか説明してください。
ja.hint: お父さんが息子に再会したときの気持ちや行動に注目しましょう。
ja.sample: お父さんは迷子の息子に駆け寄り、ぎゅっと抱きしめて、帰ってきたことを祝う大きなパーティーを開きました。

local.prompt: Describe the story of the lost son and how his father reacted when he returned.
local.hint: Focus on the father's feelings and actions when he saw his son again.
local.sample: The father ran to his lost son, hugged him tightly, and threw a big party to celebrate his return.

zh.prompt: 描述迷失的兒子故事，以及他回來時父親的反應。
zh.hint: 著重於父親看到兒子時的感受和行動。
zh.sample: 父親跑向迷失的兒子，緊緊抱住他，並舉辦盛大派對慶祝他的回歸。

en.prompt: Describe the story of the lost son and how his father reacted when he returned.
en.hint: Focus on the father's feelings and actions when he saw his son again.
en.sample: The father ran to his lost son, hugged him tightly, and threw a big party to celebrate his return.

title: What Does a Daddy Do?
prompt: Explain what a daddy does to show love and care for his family.
hint: Think about actions like protecting, teaching, and loving.
sample: A daddy listens to God, protects his family, teaches important lessons, and loves his children unconditionally.

ja.prompt: お父さんは家族に愛や思いやりを示すために何をしますか？説明してください。
ja.hint: 守ること、教えること、愛することなどの行動を考えてみましょう。
ja.sample: お父さんは神様の言葉に耳を傾け、家族を守り、大切なことを教え、無条件に子どもを愛します。

local.prompt: Explain what a daddy does to show love and care for his family.

zh.prompt: 解釋爸爸如何表達對家人的愛與關心。
zh.hint: 想想像保護、教導和愛護等行為。
zh.sample: 爸爸會聆聽神的話語，保護家人，教導重要的事情，並無條件地愛孩子。

en.prompt: Explain what a daddy does to show love and care for his family.
en.hint: Think about actions like protecting, teaching, and loving.
en.sample: A daddy listens to God, protects his family, teaches important lessons, and loves his children unconditionally.
